items.briefing:
Australian energy provider Origin has suffered a data breach exposing customer information — if you're an Origin customer, watch for phishing emails or calls using your personal details. Separately, a new Australian study confirms that AI is making ransomware attacks more effective and harder to detect, raising the risk for local organisations including training providers.

A new strain of malware called Dolphin X is also using AI to identify and prioritise high-value targets before attacking. **Practical tip:** Be extra cautious with any unexpected emails or messages referencing your energy account or personal details — don't click links; go directly to the official website instead.

featured.title: Australian energy provider Origin says data breach exposes client data - BleepingComputer
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider data breach directly impacts thousands of local consumers' personal information.
